{{StoryArc|Prime Suspect|Shattered Lenses|Shattered Glass Story Arc}} {{Spoiler Warning}} '''Shattered Bridges''' is October 2019's [[Special Mission|Spotlight]] Mission == Synopsis == [https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/9169/spotlight-mission-shattered-bridges According to this]... ''[[Optimus Prime|Optimus]] is missing, [[Prowl]] is missing, [[Wheeljack]] and [[Jetfire]] [[Awaken and Corrupt|have disappeared]] into [[Generations|a Chrono-Mission]], new dangers are appearing at every turn. Important intel comes to the Autobot base from a questionable source and it sends two uneasy Autobots on a journey with brave new partners.'' ''Will mysterious evil forces be sent back? Will friends and foes join together? Will anyone survive? Follow the path if you dare, because a dangerous journey awaits on the other side of SHATTERED BRIDGES!'' == Changes/Rewards == No changes to rewards. == Transcript == THIS SPOTLIGHT MISSION IS BRAND NEW, SO TO BE SURE... {{Spoiler Warning}} '''SPOILER. ''ALERT.''''' === Chapter 1 - Snap === ====Mission 1 - Crack==== ===== Part 1 ===== {{Dia|red|[[Marissa Faireborn]]|[[Optimus Prime (MV1)|Optimus]], [[Bumblebee (DOTM)|Bumblebee]], we've been given [[Prowl]]'s [[Prime Suspect|Evidence Log]]. There's also...an unique and troubling detail we need to discuss.}} {{Dia|darkred|[[Optimus Prime (MV1)|Optimus Prime]]|That should shed light on the disappearance of Prowl and [[Optimus Prime|his Prime]]. What is the missing detail?}} {{Dia|red|Marissa Faireborn|It's about WHO delivered the message. [[Megatron]] and [[Starscream]].}} {{Dia|darkred|[[Bumblebee (DOTM)|Bumblebee]]|They looking for a reward? Turning themselves in? Offering to fight each other for our amusement?}} {{Dia|red|Marissa Faireborn|This seems weird I know but I promise we can explain...}} {{Dia|#4B4B4B|[[Megatron|Megatron (Shattered Glass)]]|Indeed, Captain Faireborn. We would be honored to have the opportunity to state our case.}} {{Dia|darkred|Bumblebee|...I just had a chill go along my transmission.}} ===== Part 2 ===== {{Dia|#4B4B4B|[[Starscream|Starscream (Shattered Glass)]]|Hey, we totally understand how this seems odd. Trust us it's throwing us for a loop to see you two.}} {{Dia|darkred|Bumblebee|Only loop you're doing is to turn tail and jet out of here as you Star-Scram!}} {{Dia|#4B4B4B|Starscream (Shattered Glass)|Hah, did you just think about that? It's quite clever. Star-Scram. Like my name, but telling me to leave.}} {{Dia|darkred|Bumblebee|...I hate everything that is happening right now. Maybe you need a brawl to drop the act.}} {{Dia|#4B4B4B|Starscream (Shattered Glass)|I never seek battle as a first option, but I will protect myself if forced to action.}} {{Dia|darkred|Bumblebee|...What is HAPPENING right now?}} ===== Part 3 ===== {{Dia|#4B4B4B|Megatron (Shattered Glass)|Hopefully that is out of your system. May we please tell you why we returned Prowl's recordings?}} {{Dia|darkred|Optimus Prime|Prowl was behaving oddly, may have harmed his own Prime. We shall run an internal investigation. You can be on your way.}} {{Dia|#4B4B4B|Megatron (Shattered Glass)|Perhaps this would be better if I just spoke to your [[Commander]] privately? Is there some way they and I could be left alone?}} {{Dia|darkred|Optimus Prime|So that's what this is about. Getting to the Commander. The only way you are alone in a room with them is if I have been atomized.}} {{Dia|#4B4B4B|Megatron (Shattered Glass)|Please, we do not have time to let anger dominate this meeting.}} {{Dia|red|Marissa Faireborn|Prime, my scans DO indicate that--}} {{Dia|darkred|Optimus Prime|In a moment Faireborn! I have some Decepticon trash to throw out.}} ====Mission 2 - Pop and Lock==== ===== Part 1 ===== {{DiaRT|red|Marissa Faireborn|OPTIMUS! COMMANDER! LISTEN TO ME!}} {{DiaC|red|This is not our Megatron and Starscream. Teletraan shows they are from a [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/Shattered_Glass newly discovered dimensional rip].}} {{Dia|#4B4B4B|Megatron (Shattered Glass)|And we hold no ill-will. We know how disorienting this is. In our world we are Earth's last line of defense against the evil Autobots.}} {{Dia|#4B4B4B|Starscream (Shattered Glass)|We knew things were off when we saw a human in the Autobot base that was well... breathing.}} {{Dia|darkred|Bumblebee|Oh... wow... and the first thing WE did was attack you!}} {{Dia|#4B4B4B|Megatron (Shattered Glass)|All is forgiven. We did little to brace you to our presence. We understand how hostile that may have seemed. Our most earnest of apologies.}} {{Dia|darkred|Optimus Prime|Apologies. Yes. That being said, we have much to discuss.}}Part 2 * Starscream: ''We just gotta' round up the bad guys, bring 'em home, and leave you to be...but I'm always open to some help on a hard mission.'' * Bumblebee: ''I hear words coming out of you, but my processor won't accept the order I'm receiving them in.'' * Starscream: ''I know, right? I'm talking to the dreaded Bumblebee, the death-stinger, the doom-bringer, the most feared Autobot lieutenant!'' * Jazz (Shattered Glass): ''Him? FEARED? You're singing the wrong tune Decepti-coward!'' * Megatron (Shattered Glass): ''Jazz! friends find cover and protect one another! Defend the humans!'' * Jazz (Shattered Glass): ''Oh you have meat with you? I'll grease my wheels with them as I dance on your graves!'' Part 3 * Optimus Prime: ''If that is how Autobots behave on your world, it may indeed be wise to combine efforts.'' * Starscream: ''Megatron, Sir! I'm showing the doctor of destruction up ahead.'' * Megatron: ''No Starscream, call a monster by his name: Ratchet.'' * Optimus Prime: ''Ratchet? He is our chief medical officer. What is he in your world?'' * Ratchet (Shattered Glass): ''Someone who dedicated myself to learning the anatomy of Bots, so I can prolong their tortures or instantly snuff the Ember of say...Megatron.'' * Starscream: ''Get behind me! No one will harm Megatron while I still function!'' * Ratchet (Shattered Glass): ''Good, he'll get to watch you get flatlined before I pull the optics from his head!'' === Chapter 2 - Fractures === ====Mission 1 - Splitting Up ==== Part 1 * Megatron: ''This is a larger escape than we anticipated, we may have to split up.'' * Optimus Prime: ''Agreed, Bee you take Starscream. Megatron and I will head over that ridge and will be in continual radio contract.'' * Starscream: ''May the light of the noble and honorable Liego Maximo shine on you my heroic brothers.'' * Megatron: ''And may your loyal Ember lead you back to us, my most trusted colleague.'' * Optimus Prime: ''Yes. Good. All of this is good. We should be on our way.'' Part 2 * Bumblebee: ''So you and Megatron, Together forever, huh?'' * Starscream: ''Not forever. One day I shall lead the Decepticons and he shall no longer be with me.'' * Bumblebee: ''HAH! I knew you'd be the same deep down.'' * Starscream: ''He has witnessed so much war, so much pain. One day he shall live his cycles out in peace. Then I shall have the great burden of requesting to lead.'' * Bumblebee: ''....Right. Oh hey! Look! An actual Decepticon!'' * [[Motormaster]]: ''Little lethal lady I met said to take your heads as trophies. Says you should back off or get knocked off.'' * Bumblebee: ''I'm weirdly glad too see you. Starscream, let's jack-knife this joker!'' Part 3 * Arcee (Shattered Glass): '' I see that pathetic delivery-boy failed to give you my message.'' * Bumblebee: ''Arcee? You're looking a tad aggressive.'' * Arcee: ''Ahhh, the bumbling Bee. It would be more satisfying to cut the stinger off someone who posed a challenge. But your screams will suffice.'' * Bumblebee: ''The Autobots of your world are very...threatening.'' * Starscream: ''Their tongues are as sharp as their blades. They take pleasure in cutting us with their words as well as their weapons.'' * Arcee: ''Is that your engines whining on you? I'm going to blast you open or go out swinging, wither way let's see what you're made of!'' ====Mission 2 - Patched Together==== Part 1 * Optimus Prime: ''Your Starscream seems to be a very trusted companion.'' * Megatron: ''Without the trust of my team how would I have been elected their leader?'' * Optimus Prime: ''Elected. The Decepticons of your world are a democracy?'' * Megatron: ''Of course, we cannot rely on the whims of the universe. We must take charge and know our vision is represented. How do you rule?'' * Optimus Prime: ''I do not...rule exactly. I was...it is very complicated. We should stay alert. Scan the area.'' * Megatron: ''Very advisable. That will give us intel, and good intel is fifty percent of the combat engagement.'' Part 2 * Megatron: ''Signals up ahead, one of your dimensions's Decepticons and one of my Autobots.'' * Wheeljack (Shattered Glass): ''You pathetic, chittering, slag-heap! This garbage you brought me is worthless!'' * [[Kickback]]: ''But Wasp and Scorpion were gathering it to make a space bridge-bridge!'' * Wheeljack: ''So you can't even steal from thieves correctly? My materials must be absolutely flawless for my perfect designs to function!'' * Optimus Prime: ''And just what is it you think you are building?'' * Kickback: ''Prime-Prime! Don't worry science friend, we just found a new source of scrap-scrap!'' Part 3 * Wheeljack: ''Well Kickback was right about new scrap, I can use parts of him for support beams at least.'' * Megatron: ''You dastardly fiend, what is your cracked clockwork mind ticking towards?'' * Wheeljack: ''We escaped here, but we left some friends behind. I'm just making sure the door stays open, maybe get a few more timelines in like I've witnessed on this world.'' * Optimus Prime: ''You mean to strand more bots here? There is no escape from this vacuum of realities.'' * Wheeljack: ''Better to rule in this pit, than kneel on Cybertron. Speaking of kneeling, a little groveling may spare you from my wrath.'' * Megatron: ''You speak bitter lies, mercy is never part of your cruel calculations.'' * Wheeljack: ''I forgot how well you know me Megatron. Truth then. None shall be spared.'' === Chapter 3 - Bursts === ====Mission 1 - Animal Magnetism==== Part 1 * Optimus Prime: ''Bumblebee, Starscream, what did you find?'' * Starscream: ''Arcee has recruited Motormaster. Bumblebee and the Commander did a commendable job in settling the situation with minimal damage.'' * Bumblebee: ''Yeah we hit them a bunch until they stopped. What about you two?'' * Megatron: ''Took in intel, quelled a chance for this to spread. Escapes seem to be contained to the one timeline fro our dimension.'' * [[Scorponok]]: ''You guys here to take away my new best friend? Because I swear to Primus I'm about to lose it.'' * Megatron: ''Who or what is that?'' * Optimus Prime: ''The answer is, as always, trouble.'' Part 2 * Scorponok: ''He ain't a Predacon, but he sure ain't acting like no Maximal I've ever seen. Except that one time with Rhinox...'' * Bumblebee: ''What are you talking about?'' * Scorponok: ''...Dropped those boxes on me...made me all flat. OH! Right! I'm here to protect my friend and destroy all who oppose him.'' * Optimus Prime: ''Your friend likely poses a threat to the delicate fabric of reality as we know it.'' * Scorponok: ''Yeah and he keeps trying to claw my face but friends around here are slim and I takes what I gets. So prepare for a fight!'' Part 3 * Optimus Prime: ''If it was a Maximal teaming up with Scorponok that means that multiple timelines from your world have diverged here as well.'' * Bumblebee: ''And I think I'm seeing the bot that jumped all nine of their lives over here.'' * [[Cheetor]]: GRRRWAAAARRRWLLLLL! * Stascream: ''Good Kitty! Nice Kitty! Maybe let's put those claws away huh?'' * Bumblebee: ''Yeah, I don't think he likes being called kitty...or chatting.'' * Cheetor: ''METAL! ENERGON! FEED! HUNGRY!'' * Megatron: ''I agree with Bumblebee, words may fail us here.'' * Cheetor: ''TALK TO MUCH! FIGHT NOW! FEEEEEED!'' ====Mission 2 - Second in Demand==== Part 1 * Optimus Prime: ''This has been a deeply trying and troubling endeavour.'' * Bumblebee (Shattered Glass): ''And the hits just keep on comin'!'' * Bumblebee: ''Oh, come on!'' * Starscream: ''Keep your distance! He is driven only to destroy. If he's this close we may be already out of time.'' * [[Megatron (ROTF)]]: ''Out of time? Yes.'' * Megatron: ''I can not hide my disgust at this twisted abomination.'' * Megatron (ROTF): ''I assure you the feeling is mutual.'' Part 2 * Megatron: ''You are a Megatron! Namesake of the noble Megatronus who gave his life to protect the Prime he loved! How dare you side with this death-bringer?'' * Megatron (ROTF): ''Your dimension sounds quaint, our Megatronus embraced all the darkness within him. So much so that he seems to have slipped into the shadows of this world.'' * Optimus Prime: ''Megatronus is missing? I thought he was powering up to some grande finale.'' * Megatron (ROFT): ''Well if it's any consolation, you wouldn't have lived to witness it.'' * Bumblebee (Shattered Glass): ''Enough of your posturing Megatron, prove yourself or move aside!'' * Megatron (ROTF): ''I must prove nothing! But I will take pleasure in eliminating this threat to our plans.'' Part 3 * Bumblebee (Shattered Glass): ''Pathetic failure after failure. No Prime can match me, mo Megatron, none even pose a challenge.'' * Bumblebee: ''Where is your Prime? A Bumblebee without an Optimus is lost, I should know.'' * Bumblebee (Shattered Glass): ''Last I saw him, I was tossing his tattered body into the void of space as he tried to convince me he still functioned.'' * Starscream: WHAT KIND OF MINDLESS MONSTER WOULD DO THAT? * Megatron: ''Team, we may not end this threat today. We may face further terrors in the days to come. But we will not allow Bumblebee one step further into this world.'' * Bumblebee (Shattered Glass): ''Draw a line, and watch me cross it.'' * Megatron: ''You heard him. DECEPTICONS! ROLL OUT!'' == Gallery == === Spotlight Mission === Shattered Bridges newsfeed.jpg Shattered Bridges newsfeed banner.jpg Shattered Bridges mail.jpg Shattered Bridges menu.jpg Shattered Bridges newsfeed.png Shattered Bridges 1 easy.jpg Shattered Bridges 2 medium.jpg Shattered Bridges 3 hard.jpg Shattered Bridges 4 expert.jpg Shattered Bridges 5 master.jpg Shattered Bridges Chapter 1.jpg Shattered Bridges Chapter 2.jpg Shattered Bridges Chapter 3.jpg 3277DD1D-8E4D-431F-BA35-487DDCC96B4D.jpeg CBEFD18F-2540-491D-96CD-8BD9C42EFBFE.jpeg [[File:Shattered Bridges menu.jpg|!50px|Menu|center]] [[File:Shattered Bridges 1 easy.jpg|100px|Easy]][[File:Shattered Bridges 2 medium.jpg|100px|Medium]][[File:Shattered Bridges 3 hard.jpg|100px|Hard]][[File:Shattered Bridges 4 expert.jpg|100px|Expert]][[File:Shattered Bridges 5 master.jpg|100px|Master]] {{GalleryChapters|Shattered Bridges}} === The ''Shattered Glass'' Bots === Megatron SG.png|Megatron Starscream SG.png|Starscream Jazz SG.png|Jazz Ratchet SG.png|Ratchet Arcee SG.png|Arcee Wheeljack SG.png|Wheeljack Cheetor SG.png|Cheetor Bumblebee SG.png|DOTM Bee
